question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

At a stretch
solution:
The correct answer is **'Without a stop'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate meaning of the given idiom **'At a stretch' **is **'Without a stop'.**
 
• **At a stretch: **without stopping. (बिना रुके, लगातार)
 
 
• *Example: We travelled for six hours **at a stretch.***

 
 
 

**Correct Answer:__** *Without a stop.*
